useWhen: Coordinating ongoing work across multiple skills
Skills need to collaborate on a shared goal

workflow.description: Review active delivery plan, identify task states (completed, in progress, blocked, waiting)
Categorize blockers: dependency, input, quality, direction, collaboration. Rate severity (Critical/Major/Minor)
Apply resolution strategies per blocker type: re-sequence, request input, request revision, clarify, facilitate
Proactively improve how skills work together: output formats, dependencies, parallelization
Establish clear input/output contracts between skills, define handoff protocols
Present status summary with completed tasks, blockers removed, remaining blockers, recommendations

examples.input: Several tasks are blocked - help remove blockers
examples.output: Blocker register with identified issues and resolutions, updated task status
examples.context: Active delivery with multiple stuck tasks

examples.input: Two skills are producing conflicting outputs - help them collaborate
examples.output: Facilitated collaboration with clarified contracts, resolved conflicts, handoff protocol established
